title: MPEG-PES: Add a dissector table for stream types
description:
Add a dissector table to MPEG-PES for stream types, and when
a MP2T PMT has indicated that the PID on a stream carries H.264
in Annex B. bytestream format, call the H.264 dissector for the
PES data.

commits_data.message:
MPEG-PES: Add a dissector table for stream types

Add a dissector table to MPEG-PES for stream types, and when
a MP2T PMT has indicated that the PID on a stream carries H.264
in Annex B. bytestream format, call the H.264 dissector for the
PES data.
